resume: In mainland France, family allowances are paid from 2 dependent children. 2026 amounts, age supplement, applying to the Caf and splitting under shared residence.
aQuoiCaSert: Family allowances help families meet children's everyday expenses. In mainland France, they are paid from 2 dependent children under 20, with no means test for entitlement, but the amount varies with household income. A supplement is added when a child reaches a certain age. Unlike in the overseas départements, no family allowance is paid for an only child.
quiEstConcerne: Families living in mainland France with at least 2 dependent children under 20.
Separated parents whose children live in shared residence.
Parents who do not yet receive benefits from the Caf (Caisse d'allocations familiales, the family benefits office) or the MSA (Mutualité sociale agricole, the farmers' social security fund).
aSavoir: Basic amount for 2 children: €152.25 per month if the household's 2024 income does not exceed €79,980, €76.13 up to €106,604, €38.07 above that (service-public.gouv.fr, checked on June 1, 2026).
For 3 children, the basic amount ranges from €86.83 to €347.32 per month depending on income. The ceilings rise with the number of children.

Age supplement (majoration pour âge): paid from age 14 for a child born before March 1, 2012, and from age 18 for a child born on or after March 1, 2012. With only 2 children, the eldest does not qualify for it.
Family with at least 3 children: a monthly flat-rate payment may be made for one year for a child who turns 20 and still lives at home, subject to the child's income.

Shared residence: parents can choose to split the family allowances, each receiving half, using form cerfa n° 14000. This choice can only be changed after one year, unless the child's residence changes. If the parents disagree, each parent automatically receives a share.

Only family allowances can be split. Other benefits (Paje, complément familial, housing benefits, ARS, ASF, AEEH) are paid in full to the designated parent; since December 1, 2025, however, each parent can receive the CMG (childcare supplement) according to their own situation.

documents.libelle: ID or residence permit of each parent
documents.detail: Valid copy, requested with your first application to the Caf.

documents.libelle: Family record book (livret de famille) or birth certificate of each child
documents.detail: Copy. Certificate free on service-public.gouv.fr or from the town hall (mairie) where the child was born.

documents.libelle: RIB (bank details slip) of the parent receiving the benefits

documents.detail: Copy, downloadable from your account on impots.gouv.fr. Your income is used in the calculation.
Recent copy (bill, rent receipt or certificate of accommodation).

documents.libelle: Judgment or agreement setting shared residence
documents.detail: Copy, to attach to the split form if shared residence was set by the judge or by an agreement.

documents.libelle: Form cerfa n° 14000, declaration in case of shared residence
documents.detail: Signed by both parents if you agree on the split. Keep a copy.

etapes.titre: Register with the Caf if you have not already
etapes.detail: Apply for benefits on caf.fr (or msa.fr under the agricultural scheme). If you already receive Caf benefits, simply declare the birth or arrival of the 2nd child.
Children correctly declared, income up to date, RIB, correct address, family situation (couple, separated, single parent). If you have separated, declare the actual date.

etapes.titre: Shared residence: choose a split or a single beneficiary
etapes.detail: Fill in form cerfa n° 14000 together and send it to the Caf or the MSA with the judge's decision or the agreement if you have one.
View the details of your payments in your "Mon Compte" account and use the Caf simulator to check the amount.

ou.detail: Online procedures in your "Mon Compte" account. To find your Caf and its reception desks, enter your postcode on caf.fr.

ou.nom: MSA (Mutualité sociale agricole, the farmers' social security fund)
ou.detail: If you are covered by the agricultural scheme.

actions.titre: Report any change in family situation to the Caf

aConfirmer: The exact amount of each parent's share when allowances are split depends on the make-up of each household: check it with the Caf simulator or with your Caf.
The amounts shown are those published by service-public.gouv.fr (page checked on June 1, 2026): if they are increased, rely on the Caf simulator.
